# PUT /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secretname}

Create or update a secret value in an organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (reqToken + reqOrgOwnership) · **ID:** `ep-040`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| secretname | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateOrUpdateSecretOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `data` | string | True | binding:Required, max length 65536 |
| `description` | string | False | truncated to 4096 runes |

## Response

**201** — empty

- **204** — secret updated (already existed)
- **400** — invalid secret name or data too long
- **404** — organization not found

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Secret names must match ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ and not start with GITEA_/GITHUB_ or be 'CI' | validation | !namePattern.MatchString(name) || forbiddenPrefixPattern.MatchString(name) || name=='CI' |
| Secret data max length is 65536 bytes | validation | len(data) > SecretDataMaxLength |
| Secret names are stored uppercase (case-insensitive matching) | business_logic | always |
| Secret description is truncated to 4096 runes | business_logic | len(description) > SecretDescriptionMaxLength |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| invalid secret name or data too long | 400 | error with message | False |
| secret not found (should not happen for create) | 404 | not found | False |

### Error Paths

- **invalid name (regex/prefix)** → CreateOrUpdateSecret → 400
- **data too long (>65536)** → InsertEncryptedSecret/UpdateSecret → 500
- **encryption fails** → CreateOrUpdateSecret → 500
